Test of the "function end names" inlay hint (#80465).

-- settings.json --
{"hints": {"functionEndNames": true}}

-- p/p.go --
package p //@inlayhints(out)

type T struct{}

func foo() {
	func() {}
}

func (T) method() {}

-- @out --
package p //@inlayhints(out)

type T struct{}

func foo() {
	func() {}
}< // foo>

func (T) method() {}< // method>
